collector_review.source_archives: Iterates every *-source directory, requires its identities manifest to match copied Rust files, deduplicates identical content, then verifies archive members and every archived digest.

collector_review.exports: The selected export test enumerates 4 selection names x 2 stage types x 2 directions, producing 16 deterministic unique case names. Its project package lives in a directory named for that case; encoded_identity.py derives case from package.parent.name, and collect.py retains each MP4 as encoded-<case>.mp4.
collector_review.owner_archives: retain_owner_fixtures.py explicitly selects five unique case keys and writes identities for each; collect.py copies each row named in that identities file and checks the archive SHA-256.
collector_review.inventory: Collector records size/SHA-256 for every produced evidence file except inventory.json itself and rechecks each recorded entry.
